messages:
ravi: Quick design huddle about the pool picker and autoscale controls — some usability things from the prototype session.
tegan: cool, what came up?
morgan: main thing: users expected selecting a pool to instantly update the cost & SLO preview but current flow requires a separate "Apply" button. they kept missing it.
elle: yeah, that Apply step feels like friction. two options: auto-apply on select (fast) or keep Apply but make it much clearer (primary CTA, brief toast).
ravi: leaning auto-apply but with a small debounce (500ms) and an undo toast: "Switched to pool X — undo". avoids accidental switching pain.
tegan: agree. add a small animation on the cost tile so it's visually obvious the numbers changed. but respect prefers-reduced-motion.
morgan: copy nit on the SLO slider: label is 'Latency' — testers assumed average. change to "SLO target (p99 ms)" and show a tiny helper link: "what is p99?"
elle: microcopy for burst CTA too: current false-positive wording 'Force burst' is aggressive. suggest 'Enable temporary burst' + one-line explanation and the exact limit.
ravi: also accessibility: pool rows are announced as generic buttons. need role="option" in a listbox pattern and announce selected state and remaining burst: aria-label="Pool X, selected, burst remaining 2.4 hours".
tegan: plus keyboard shortcuts: up/down to move in list, enter to select, and space to preview without selecting — is preview useful?
morgan: preview is handy for exploring cost differences. space for preview, enter to confirm seems intuitive but might conflict with other patterns. add a small tooltip explaining keyboard hints on focus.
elle: visual density issue: when many pools, the burst badge pushes the pool name and truncates it. use compact numeric badge like '2.4h' and full text in tooltip. for SR, ensure aria-describedby points to full phrase.
ravi: SLO slider track color uses green for safe and orange for warning — color only indicators fail for colorblind. append text state 'OK'/'Warn' next to slider and add icon with aria-hidden true.
tegan: test request: add a Cypress spec that selects a pool, asserts the cost preview updates, checks aria-live announces new estimate, and verifies space triggers preview state.
morgan: one more tiny thing: when switching pools with different max GPUs, the min/max steppers should reconcile (if min > max show validation inline) and the error must be announced via aria-live polite.
elle: accept language: "Min GPUs cannot exceed Max GPUs" with inline helper 'adjust max or reduce min'.
ravi: i'll PR copy + aria changes. who can take the small debounce + undo toast and keyboard hints?
tegan: i'll do debounce + toast and put the keyboard hint into the component.
morgan: i'll add the Cypress test.
elle: i'll update Figma and push copy tweaks: https://figma.com/file/zxy1234/pool-picker-autoscale-clarity — comments on the right.
toolbot: a11y-scan queued: will re-run after changes merged. Reminder in 24h.
ravi: awesome, thanks all — will ping when PRs are up.
